about_the_game:
Killer Situation is a short stealth/action horror game set on a cold winter night just days before Christmas. You play as Rachel Dunn, an enthusiastic scientist who, over the past few years, has grown severely paranoid and isolated after discovering the true nature of her workplace.

Sudden threats and close calls pushed her to turn her home into an impenetrable fortress with bullet-proof windows, steel-reinforced doors, cameras and smart security system.

No one can get in without access - or out...

But one night, her smart home is breached. A serial killer has just entered Rachel's home, known as the "Horse Mask Killer" from the 80s.

Unable to control her smart home anymore, Rachel has to escape from her own house while the killer is trying to murder her.

Features:

  • Short, Focused Horror – Finishing one playthrough should take about an hour (depending on your skill of course).

  • Stealth/Action – Run, hide, loop, and use the environment to your advantage.

  • Survival – Find items to defend yourself, patch yourself up, or throw something at the killer to slow him down.

  • Puzzles – Search the house and figure out how to escape using the items you find and the environemnt around you.

  • Replayability – Puzzles, item locations, and interactions are randomized each playthrough, with three unique ending outcomes.

  • Multiple Endings – Three unique ways to finish the game with each having different interactions/puzzles and ending scenes.

  • Story - Other than Intro/Ending sequences the story is hidden in clues, environment and pages from Rachel's diary scattered throughout the house.

content_descriptors.notes: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Targetting 1080p@ low settings 60 fps
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super or AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Targetting 1080p@ high settings 60 fps

short_description: On a snowy night just before Christmas, your secure smart home is breached. A serial killer has come for you and you are trapped with him in your own house. Search for items and figure a way out while evading the killer in this this short, intense horror experience.
